name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Grasweberhof
beschreibung: The Grasweberhof in Ebbs is a charming working farm offering comfortable, well-furnished holiday apartments. Each unit comes fully equipped with its own private kitchen and bathroom, ensuring optimal flexibility. Situated peacefully on the village outskirts, the property enjoys sweeping, uninterrupted views of the majestic Kaiser Mountains. Guests can immerse themselves in genuine farm life and nature. Ebbs is ideally positioned near the German border and the historic fortress town of Kufstein, surrounded by superb trails for hiking, cycling, and scenic walks along the River Inn.
